framework.name: CMMC Level 2
framework.description: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) 2.0 Level 2 — 110 practices for the protection of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), aligned to NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2.

requirements.name: Authorized Access Control
requirements.description: Limit system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other systems).

requirements.name: Transaction & Function Control
requirements.description: Limit system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

requirements.name: Control CUI Flow
requirements.description: Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations.

requirements.name: Separation of Duties
requirements.description: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion.

requirements.name: Least Privilege
requirements.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.

requirements.name: Non-Privileged Account Use
requirements.description: Use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing nonsecurity functions.

requirements.name: Privileged Functions
requirements.description: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs.

requirements.name: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
requirements.description: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts.

requirements.name: Privacy & Security Notices
requirements.description: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with applicable CUI rules.

requirements.name: Session Lock
requirements.description: Use session lock with pattern-hiding displays to prevent access and viewing of data after a period of inactivity.

requirements.name: Session Termination
requirements.description: Terminate (automatically) a user session after a defined condition.

requirements.name: Control Remote Access
requirements.description: Monitor and control remote access sessions.

requirements.name: Remote Access Confidentiality
requirements.description: Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.

requirements.name: Remote Access Routing
requirements.description: Route remote access via managed access control points.

requirements.name: Privileged Remote Access
requirements.description: Authorize remote execution of privileged commands and remote access to security-relevant information.

requirements.name: Wireless Access Authorization
requirements.description: Authorize wireless access prior to allowing such connections.

requirements.name: Wireless Access Protection
requirements.description: Protect wireless access using authentication and encryption.

requirements.name: Mobile Device Connection
requirements.description: Control connection of mobile devices.

requirements.name: Encrypt CUI on Mobile
requirements.description: Encrypt CUI on mobile devices and mobile computing platforms.

requirements.name: External Connections
requirements.description: Verify and control/limit connections to and use of external systems.

requirements.name: Portable Storage Use
requirements.description: Limit use of portable storage devices on external systems.

requirements.name: Control Public Information
requirements.description: Control CUI posted or processed on publicly accessible systems.

requirements.name: Role-Based Risk Awareness
requirements.description: Ensure that managers, systems administrators, and users of organizational systems are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities and of the applicable policies, standards, and procedures related to the security of those systems.

requirements.name: Role-Based Training
requirements.description: Ensure that personnel are trained to carry out their assigned information security-related duties and responsibilities.

requirements.name: Insider Threat Awareness
requirements.description: Provide security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.

requirements.name: System Auditing
requirements.description: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

requirements.name: User Accountability
requirements.description: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be uniquely traced to those users so they can be held accountable for their actions.

requirements.name: Event Review
requirements.description: Review and update logged events.

requirements.name: Audit Failure Alerting
requirements.description: Alert in the event of an audit logging process failure.

requirements.name: Audit Correlation
requirements.description: Correlate audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes for investigation and response to indications of unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity.

requirements.name: Reduction & Reporting
requirements.description: Provide audit record reduction and report generation to support on-demand analysis and reporting.

requirements.name: Authoritative Time Source
requirements.description: Provide a system capability that compares and synchronizes internal system clocks with an authoritative source to generate time stamps for audit records.

requirements.name: Audit Protection
requirements.description: Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

requirements.name: Audit Management
requirements.description: Limit management of audit logging functionality to a subset of privileged users.

requirements.name: System Baselining
requirements.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems (including hardware, software, firmware, and documentation) throughout the respective system development life cycles.

requirements.name: Security Configuration Enforcement
requirements.description: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for information technology products employed in organizational systems.

requirements.name: System Change Management
requirements.description: Track, review, approve or disapprove, and log changes to organizational systems.

requirements.name: Security Impact Analysis
requirements.description: Analyze the security impact of changes prior to implementation.

requirements.name: Access Restrictions for Change
requirements.description: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to organizational systems.

requirements.name: Least Functionality
requirements.description: Employ the principle of least functionality by configuring organizational systems to provide only essential capabilities.

requirements.name: Nonessential Functionality
requirements.description: Restrict, disable, or prevent the use of nonessential programs, functions, ports, protocols, and services.

requirements.name: Application Execution Policy
requirements.description: Apply deny-by-exception (blacklisting) policy to prevent the use of unauthorized software or deny-all, permit-by-exception (whitelisting) policy to allow the execution of authorized software.

requirements.name: User-Installed Software
requirements.description: Control and monitor user-installed software.

requirements.name: Identification
requirements.description: Identify system users, processes acting on behalf of users, and devices.

requirements.name: Authentication
requirements.description: Authenticate (or verify) the identities of users, processes, or devices, as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational systems.

requirements.name: Multifactor Authentication
requirements.description: Use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

requirements.name: Replay-Resistant Authentication
requirements.description: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non-privileged accounts.

requirements.name: Identifier Reuse
requirements.description: Prevent reuse of identifiers for a defined period.

requirements.name: Identifier Handling
requirements.description: Disable identifiers after a defined period of inactivity.

requirements.name: Password Complexity
requirements.description: Enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created.

requirements.name: Password Reuse
requirements.description: Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations.

requirements.name: Temporary Passwords
requirements.description: Allow temporary password use for system logons with an immediate change to a permanent password.

requirements.name: Cryptographically-Protected Passwords
requirements.description: Store and transmit only cryptographically-protected passwords.

requirements.name: Obscure Feedback
requirements.description: Obscure feedback of authentication information.

requirements.name: Incident Handling
requirements.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities.

requirements.name: Incident Reporting
requirements.description: Track, document, and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization.

requirements.name: Incident Response Testing
requirements.description: Test the organizational incident response capability.

requirements.name: Perform Maintenance
requirements.description: Perform maintenance on organizational systems.

requirements.name: System Maintenance Control
requirements.description: Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel used to conduct system maintenance.

requirements.name: Equipment Sanitization
requirements.description: Ensure equipment removed for off-site maintenance is sanitized of any CUI.

requirements.name: Media Inspection
requirements.description: Check media containing diagnostic and test programs for malicious code before the media are used in organizational systems.

requirements.name: Nonlocal Maintenance MFA
requirements.description: Require multifactor authentication to establish nonlocal maintenance sessions via external network connections and terminate such connections when nonlocal maintenance is complete.

requirements.name: Maintenance Personnel
requirements.description: Supervise the maintenance activities of maintenance personnel without required access authorization.

requirements.name: Media Protection
requirements.description: Protect (i.e., physically control and securely store) system media containing CUI, both paper and digital.

requirements.name: Media Access
requirements.description: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users.

requirements.name: Media Disposal
requirements.description: Sanitize or destroy system media containing CUI before disposal or release for reuse.

requirements.name: Media Markings
requirements.description: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations.

requirements.name: Media Accountability
requirements.description: Control access to media containing CUI and maintain accountability for media during transport outside of controlled areas.

requirements.name: Portable Storage Encryption
requirements.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of CUI stored on digital media during transport unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

requirements.name: Removable Media
requirements.description: Control the use of removable media on system components.

requirements.name: Shared Media
requirements.description: Prohibit the use of portable storage devices when such devices have no identifiable owner.

requirements.name: Protect Backups
requirements.description: Protect the confidentiality of backup CUI at storage locations.

requirements.name: Screen Individuals
requirements.description: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to organizational systems containing CUI.

requirements.name: Personnel Actions
requirements.description: Ensure that organizational systems containing CUI are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.

requirements.name: Limit Physical Access
requirements.description: Limit physical access to organizational systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.

requirements.name: Monitor Facility
requirements.description: Protect and monitor the physical facility and support infrastructure for organizational systems.

requirements.name: Escort Visitors
requirements.description: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity.

requirements.name: Physical Access Logs
requirements.description: Maintain audit logs of physical access.

requirements.name: Manage Physical Access
requirements.description: Control and manage physical access devices.

requirements.name: Alternative Work Sites
requirements.description: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites.

requirements.name: Risk Assessments
requirements.description: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations (including mission, functions, image, or reputation), organizational assets, and individuals, resulting from the operation of organizational systems and the associated processing, storage, or transmission of CUI.

requirements.name: Vulnerability Scan
requirements.description: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities affecting those systems and applications are identified.

requirements.name: Vulnerability Remediation
requirements.description: Remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments.

requirements.name: Security Control Assessment
requirements.description: Periodically assess the security controls in organizational systems to determine if the controls are effective in their application.

requirements.name: Plan of Action
requirements.description: Develop and implement plans of action designed to correct deficiencies and reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities in organizational systems.

requirements.name: Continuous Monitoring
requirements.description: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis to ensure the continued effectiveness of the controls.

requirements.name: System Security Plan
requirements.description: Develop, document, and periodically update system security plans that describe system boundaries, system environments of operation, how security requirements are implemented, and the relationships with or connections to other systems.

requirements.name: Boundary Protection
requirements.description: Monitor, control, and protect communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational systems.

requirements.name: Security Engineering
requirements.description: Employ architectural designs, software development techniques, and systems engineering principles that promote effective information security within organizational systems.

requirements.name: Role Separation
requirements.description: Separate user functionality from system management functionality.

requirements.name: Shared Resource Control
requirements.description: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

requirements.name: Public-Access System Separation
requirements.description: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.

requirements.name: Network Communication by Exception
requirements.description: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception (i.e., deny all, permit by exception).

requirements.name: Split Tunneling
requirements.description: Prevent remote devices from simultaneously establishing non-remote connections with organizational systems and communicating via some other connection to resources in external networks (i.e., split tunneling).

requirements.name: Data in Transit
requirements.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

requirements.name: Connections Termination
requirements.description: Terminate network connections associated with communications sessions at the end of the sessions or after a defined period of inactivity.

requirements.name: Key Management
requirements.description: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography employed in organizational systems.

requirements.name: CUI Encryption
requirements.description: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.

requirements.name: Collaborative Device Control
requirements.description: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and provide indication of devices in use to users present at the device.

requirements.name: Mobile Code
requirements.description: Control and monitor the use of mobile code.

requirements.name: Voice over Internet Protocol
requirements.description: Control and monitor the use of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) technologies.

requirements.name: Communications Authenticity
requirements.description: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

requirements.name: Data at Rest
requirements.description: Protect the confidentiality of CUI at rest.

requirements.name: Flaw Remediation
requirements.description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.

requirements.name: Malicious Code Protection
requirements.description: Provide protection from malicious code at designated locations within organizational systems.

requirements.name: Security Alerts & Advisories
requirements.description: Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response.

requirements.name: Update Malicious Code Protection
requirements.description: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.

requirements.name: System & File Scanning
requirements.description: Perform periodic scans of organizational systems and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.

requirements.name: Monitor Communications for Attacks
requirements.description: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.

requirements.name: Identify Unauthorized Use
requirements.description: Identify unauthorized use of organizational systems.

policyTemplates.name: Access Control Policy
policyTemplates.description: Governs how access to systems and CUI is authorized, provisioned, reviewed, and revoked, including least privilege, separation of duties, remote access, wireless, and external systems.

content.text: Access Control Policy
Purpose
Governs how access to systems and CUI is authorized, provisioned, reviewed, and revoked, including least privilege, separation of duties, remote access, wireless, and external systems.
Scope

This policy applies to all personnel, contractors, systems, and facilities that store, process, or transmit Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and to the people and third parties acting on the organization's behalf.
Policy Requirements
The organization implements the following CMMC Level 2 practices in the Access Control domain:
AC.L2-3.1.1 — Limit system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other systems).
AC.L2-3.1.2 — Limit system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.
AC.L2-3.1.3 — Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations.
AC.L2-3.1.4 — Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion.
AC.L2-3.1.5 — Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.
AC.L2-3.1.6 — Use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing nonsecurity functions.
AC.L2-3.1.7 — Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs.
AC.L2-3.1.8 — Limit unsuccessful logon attempts.
AC.L2-3.1.9 — Provide privacy and security notices consistent with applicable CUI rules.
AC.L2-3.1.10 — Use session lock with pattern-hiding displays to prevent access and viewing of data after a period of inactivity.
AC.L2-3.1.11 — Terminate (automatically) a user session after a defined condition.
AC.L2-3.1.12 — Monitor and control remote access sessions.
AC.L2-3.1.13 — Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.
AC.L2-3.1.14 — Route remote access via managed access control points.
AC.L2-3.1.15 — Authorize remote execution of privileged commands and remote access to security-relevant information.
AC.L2-3.1.16 — Authorize wireless access prior to allowing such connections.
AC.L2-3.1.17 — Protect wireless access using authentication and encryption.
AC.L2-3.1.18 — Control connection of mobile devices.
AC.L2-3.1.19 — Encrypt CUI on mobile devices and mobile computing platforms.
AC.L2-3.1.20 — Verify and control/limit connections to and use of external systems.
AC.L2-3.1.21 — Limit use of portable storage devices on external systems.
AC.L2-3.1.22 — Control CUI posted or processed on publicly accessible systems.
Roles and Responsibilities

Control owners are accountable for implementing and evidencing the practices above. The security function reviews implementation at least annually and reports exceptions through the risk management process.
Exceptions
Exceptions require documented risk acceptance by the system owner and the security function, with a defined expiry and compensating controls where applicable.
Review
This policy is reviewed at least annually and after significant changes to the environment or to CMMC requirements.

content.text: Identification and Authentication Policy
Purpose
Defines identity management, multifactor authentication, and password and identifier lifecycle requirements.
Scope

This policy applies to all personnel, contractors, systems, and facilities that store, process, or transmit Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and to the people and third parties acting on the organization's behalf.
Policy Requirements
The organization implements the following CMMC Level 2 practices in the Identification and Authentication domain:
IA.L2-3.5.1 — Identify system users, processes acting on behalf of users, and devices.
IA.L2-3.5.2 — Authenticate (or verify) the identities of users, processes, or devices, as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational systems.
IA.L2-3.5.3 — Use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.
IA.L2-3.5.4 — Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non-privileged accounts.
IA.L2-3.5.5 — Prevent reuse of identifiers for a defined period.
IA.L2-3.5.6 — Disable identifiers after a defined period of inactivity.
IA.L2-3.5.7 — Enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created.
IA.L2-3.5.8 — Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations.
IA.L2-3.5.9 — Allow temporary password use for system logons with an immediate change to a permanent password.
IA.L2-3.5.10 — Store and transmit only cryptographically-protected passwords.
IA.L2-3.5.11 — Obscure feedback of authentication information.
Roles and Responsibilities

Control owners are accountable for implementing and evidencing the practices above. The security function reviews implementation at least annually and reports exceptions through the risk management process.

policyTemplates.name: System and Communications Protection Policy
policyTemplates.description: Governs boundary protection, network segmentation, cryptographic protection of CUI in transit and at rest, key management, and session integrity.

content.text: System and Communications Protection Policy
Purpose
Governs boundary protection, network segmentation, cryptographic protection of CUI in transit and at rest, key management, and session integrity.
Scope

This policy applies to all personnel, contractors, systems, and facilities that store, process, or transmit Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and to the people and third parties acting on the organization's behalf.
Policy Requirements
The organization implements the following CMMC Level 2 practices in the System and Communications Protection domain:

SC.L2-3.13.1 — Monitor, control, and protect communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational systems.
SC.L2-3.13.2 — Employ architectural designs, software development techniques, and systems engineering principles that promote effective information security within organizational systems.
SC.L2-3.13.3 — Separate user functionality from system management functionality.
SC.L2-3.13.4 — Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.
SC.L2-3.13.5 — Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.
SC.L2-3.13.6 — Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception (i.e., deny all, permit by exception).

SC.L2-3.13.7 — Prevent remote devices from simultaneously establishing non-remote connections with organizational systems and communicating via some other connection to resources in external networks (i.e., split tunneling).
SC.L2-3.13.8 — Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.
SC.L2-3.13.9 — Terminate network connections associated with communications sessions at the end of the sessions or after a defined period of inactivity.
SC.L2-3.13.10 — Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography employed in organizational systems.
SC.L2-3.13.11 — Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.
SC.L2-3.13.12 — Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and provide indication of devices in use to users present at the device.
SC.L2-3.13.13 — Control and monitor the use of mobile code.
SC.L2-3.13.14 — Control and monitor the use of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) technologies.
SC.L2-3.13.15 — Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.
SC.L2-3.13.16 — Protect the confidentiality of CUI at rest.
Roles and Responsibilities

Control owners are accountable for implementing and evidencing the practices above. The security function reviews implementation at least annually and reports exceptions through the risk management process.
Exceptions
Exceptions require documented risk acceptance by the system owner and the security function, with a defined expiry and compensating controls where applicable.
Review
This policy is reviewed at least annually and after significant changes to the environment or to CMMC requirements.

policyTemplates.name: System and Information Integrity Policy
policyTemplates.description: Governs flaw remediation, malicious code protection, security alert handling, and system monitoring for attacks and unauthorized use.

content.text: System and Information Integrity Policy
Purpose
Governs flaw remediation, malicious code protection, security alert handling, and system monitoring for attacks and unauthorized use.
Scope

This policy applies to all personnel, contractors, systems, and facilities that store, process, or transmit Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and to the people and third parties acting on the organization's behalf.
Policy Requirements
The organization implements the following CMMC Level 2 practices in the System and Information Integrity domain:
SI.L2-3.14.1 — Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.
SI.L2-3.14.2 — Provide protection from malicious code at designated locations within organizational systems.
SI.L2-3.14.3 — Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response.
SI.L2-3.14.4 — Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.
SI.L2-3.14.5 — Perform periodic scans of organizational systems and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.
SI.L2-3.14.6 — Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.
SI.L2-3.14.7 — Identify unauthorized use of organizational systems.
Roles and Responsibilities

Control owners are accountable for implementing and evidencing the practices above. The security function reviews implementation at least annually and reports exceptions through the risk management process.
Exceptions
Exceptions require documented risk acceptance by the system owner and the security function, with a defined expiry and compensating controls where applicable.
Review
This policy is reviewed at least annually and after significant changes to the environment or to CMMC requirements.

taskTemplates.name: Review user access and privileges
taskTemplates.description: Recertify user accounts, roles, and privileged access; remove access no longer required.

taskTemplates.name: Review remote access configurations
taskTemplates.description: Verify remote access routes through managed access control points and that encryption is enforced.

taskTemplates.name: Deliver security awareness training
taskTemplates.description: Deliver and record annual awareness training, including insider threat indicators.

taskTemplates.name: Review and update logged events
taskTemplates.description: Review the set of logged event types and adjust to current threat and audit needs.

taskTemplates.name: Review audit records for anomalies
taskTemplates.description: Review correlated audit records for unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity.

taskTemplates.name: Review baseline configurations
taskTemplates.description: Verify system baselines and inventory remain accurate and hardening settings are enforced.

taskTemplates.name: Review user-installed software
taskTemplates.description: Audit installed software against the approved list and remove unauthorized applications.

taskTemplates.name: Validate MFA enrollment coverage
taskTemplates.description: Confirm multifactor authentication is enforced for privileged and network accounts.

taskTemplates.name: Test the incident response plan
taskTemplates.description: Exercise the incident response capability and record results and corrective actions.

taskTemplates.name: Review maintenance activity records
taskTemplates.description: Verify maintenance was authorized, supervised where required, and equipment sanitized before off-site service.

taskTemplates.name: Sanitize and dispose of media
taskTemplates.description: Sanitize or destroy media containing CUI before disposal or reuse and record the disposition.

taskTemplates.name: Verify backup protection
taskTemplates.description: Confirm backups containing CUI are encrypted and access to backup locations is restricted.

taskTemplates.name: Review screening and offboarding records
taskTemplates.description: Confirm screening was completed before access was granted and access was revoked on termination or transfer.

taskTemplates.name: Review physical access logs
taskTemplates.description: Review facility access logs for unauthorized or anomalous entry.

taskTemplates.name: Review physical access devices
taskTemplates.description: Inventory and reconcile keys, badges, and other physical access devices.

taskTemplates.name: Conduct vulnerability scans
taskTemplates.description: Scan systems and applications for vulnerabilities and record results.

taskTemplates.name: Remediate identified vulnerabilities
taskTemplates.description: Remediate or formally accept vulnerabilities according to assessed risk.

taskTemplates.name: Perform organizational risk assessment
taskTemplates.description: Assess risk to operations, assets, and individuals from systems processing CUI.

taskTemplates.name: Assess security controls
taskTemplates.description: Assess control effectiveness and document findings.

taskTemplates.name: Update the system security plan
taskTemplates.description: Review and update the SSP covering boundaries, environment, and control implementation.

taskTemplates.name: Review plan of action and milestones
taskTemplates.description: Review POA&M items for progress and closure evidence.

taskTemplates.name: Review boundary and firewall rules
taskTemplates.description: Verify deny-by-default rules and review exceptions at network boundaries.

taskTemplates.name: Review cryptographic key management
taskTemplates.description: Review key generation, rotation, storage, and retirement practices.

taskTemplates.name: Update malicious code protection
taskTemplates.description: Confirm anti-malware definitions and engines are current across managed endpoints.

taskTemplates.name: Review system monitoring alerts
taskTemplates.description: Review monitoring alerts for attacks, indicators of attack, and unauthorized use.

controlTemplates.name: Account Authorization and Least Privilege
controlTemplates.description: Authorize accounts and devices, restrict permitted transactions and functions, separate duties, and enforce least privilege including use of non-privileged accounts for nonsecurity functions.

controlTemplates.name: Session and Logon Controls
controlTemplates.description: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts, present required notices, and lock or terminate sessions after inactivity or defined conditions.

controlTemplates.name: Remote Access Management
controlTemplates.description: Monitor and control remote access, encrypt remote sessions, route through managed access control points, and authorize privileged remote actions.

controlTemplates.name: Wireless and Mobile Device Access
controlTemplates.description: Authorize and protect wireless access, control mobile device connections, and encrypt CUI on mobile platforms.

controlTemplates.name: External Systems and CUI Flow Control
controlTemplates.description: Control the flow of CUI, verify and limit use of external systems and portable storage, and control CUI on publicly accessible systems.

controlTemplates.name: Security Awareness and Role-Based Training
controlTemplates.description: Make personnel aware of security risks and applicable policy, train them for their assigned security duties, and cover insider threat indicators.

controlTemplates.name: Audit Logging and User Accountability
controlTemplates.description: Create and retain audit logs sufficient for investigation, uniquely attribute actions to users, and review the set of logged events.

controlTemplates.name: Audit Monitoring, Correlation, and Reporting
controlTemplates.description: Alert on logging failures, correlate records for investigation, support on-demand reporting, and synchronize clocks to an authoritative time source.

controlTemplates.name: Audit Information Protection
controlTemplates.description: Protect audit records and tooling from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion, and restrict who can manage logging.

controlTemplates.name: Baseline Configuration and Inventory
controlTemplates.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories and enforce security configuration settings across IT products.

controlTemplates.name: Change Control and Security Impact Analysis
controlTemplates.description: Track, review, and approve changes, analyze security impact before implementation, and enforce access restrictions for change.

controlTemplates.name: Least Functionality and Software Restriction
controlTemplates.description: Provide only essential capabilities, disable nonessential services and ports, enforce allow/deny listing, and control user-installed software.

controlTemplates.name: Identification and Authentication of Users and Devices
controlTemplates.description: Identify users, processes, and devices, authenticate them before granting access, and obscure authentication feedback.

controlTemplates.name: Multifactor and Replay-Resistant Authentication
controlTemplates.description: Require MFA for privileged and network access and employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms.

controlTemplates.name: Identifier and Password Lifecycle Management
controlTemplates.description: Manage identifier reuse and inactivity disabling, and enforce password complexity, reuse limits, temporary password handling, and cryptographic protection.

controlTemplates.name: Incident Response Capability
controlTemplates.description: Maintain an operational incident handling capability covering preparation through recovery, report incidents to designated authorities, and test the capability.

controlTemplates.name: System Maintenance Controls
controlTemplates.description: Perform and control system maintenance, sanitize equipment removed off-site, inspect diagnostic media, require MFA for nonlocal maintenance, and supervise unescorted maintenance personnel.

controlTemplates.name: Media Handling, Marking, and Accountability
controlTemplates.description: Physically control and securely store media containing CUI, limit access to authorized users, apply required markings, and maintain accountability during transport.

controlTemplates.name: Media Sanitization and Disposal
controlTemplates.description: Sanitize or destroy media containing CUI before disposal or release for reuse.

controlTemplates.name: Removable Media and Backup Protection
controlTemplates.description: Encrypt CUI on digital media in transport, control removable media use, prohibit unowned portable devices, and protect backup confidentiality.

controlTemplates.name: Personnel Screening and Access Changes
controlTemplates.description: Screen individuals before authorizing access to CUI and protect systems during and after terminations and transfers.

controlTemplates.name: Physical Access Authorization and Devices
controlTemplates.description: Limit physical access to authorized individuals, escort and monitor visitors, and control and manage physical access devices.

controlTemplates.name: Facility Monitoring and Access Logging
controlTemplates.description: Protect and monitor the physical facility and supporting infrastructure and maintain physical access audit logs.

controlTemplates.name: Alternate Work Site Safeguards
controlTemplates.description: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites.

controlTemplates.name: Organizational Risk Assessment
controlTemplates.description: Periodically assess risk to operations, assets, and individuals arising from systems that process, store, or transmit CUI.

controlTemplates.name: Vulnerability Scanning and Remediation
controlTemplates.description: Scan for vulnerabilities periodically and on new disclosures, and remediate in accordance with assessed risk.

controlTemplates.name: Control Assessment and Continuous Monitoring
controlTemplates.description: Periodically assess control effectiveness and monitor controls on an ongoing basis.

controlTemplates.name: Plans of Action and System Security Planning
controlTemplates.description: Maintain plans of action to correct deficiencies and develop and update system security plans describing boundaries and control implementation.

controlTemplates.name: Boundary Protection and Network Segmentation
controlTemplates.description: Monitor and protect communications at external and key internal boundaries, isolate publicly accessible components, deny traffic by default, and prevent split tunneling.

controlTemplates.name: Secure Architecture and Functional Separation
controlTemplates.description: Apply security engineering principles, separate user from management functionality, and prevent unauthorized transfer via shared resources.

controlTemplates.name: Cryptographic Protection of CUI
controlTemplates.description: Encrypt CUI in transit and at rest, employ FIPS-validated cryptography, and manage cryptographic keys.

controlTemplates.name: Session and Communications Integrity
controlTemplates.description: Terminate sessions at end or after inactivity and protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

controlTemplates.name: Collaborative Computing, Mobile Code, and VoIP
controlTemplates.description: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices, indicate device use, and control and monitor mobile code and VoIP.

controlTemplates.name: Flaw Remediation and Security Alerting
controlTemplates.description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner and act on security alerts and advisories.

controlTemplates.name: Malicious Code Protection
controlTemplates.description: Provide malicious code protection at designated locations, keep mechanisms updated, and perform periodic and real-time scanning.

controlTemplates.name: System Monitoring and Unauthorized Use Detection
controlTemplates.description: Monitor systems and inbound/outbound traffic for attacks and identify unauthorized use.
